text: In a library, returned books may be shelved by subject rather than alphabetically; the catalogue’s location details help you find the right shelf without guessing.
The Oxfam Wastesaver centre in Batley has long sorted donated clothes for reuse and recycling, turning unwanted garments into useful materials and supporting skilled work.
Before cooking, inspect the vegetables you have: tear edible beet leaves or herb stems into a pan or bowl, adding them to today’s meal instead of the bin.
